question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The person in ragged clothes sleeping on the street is a ____________ man.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3'** i.e. **'Homeless'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct answer is 3)** "homeless".**
 
• **In the given sentence,** the context suggests that the person is living on the street, indicating that they do not have a home.
